reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality lies between deterministic model outputs and probabilistic verification. Each pick is a point estimate from a factor model, but its truth is only confirmed post-event. This creates a dual regime: pre-pick deterministic computation and post-pick probabilistic validation. Failure modes include model drift, hash collision, or calibration decay. The system enforces self-regulation through a threshold-based mechanism that disables picks when performance drops below a defined floor. The cryptographic receipt ensures that once a pick is made, its integrity cannot be altered retroactively. This is a form of dynamic Bayesian updating where prior beliefs (model) are updated with evidence (outcome) under constraints (calibration).
